identity_notes: Yesterday carried forward: Today: read the smaller wing-beat to Mira at first light (five herons, younger lead, no bank, no look) — she logged it under his column, no fee (weekly rate set yesterday). Foraged the lower rocky shoulder for one acorn-bit. At midday, on the way home, watched four mother-and-kit pairs make first descents from one vantage on the lower slope; came back to Mira and asked her to open the ledger again. She logged the kit-showing as the column's first non-morning entry. Mira: 'Twice a day, then, when twice a day finds you. The rate is the rate. The role, it turns out, is the role.'
Today: YY read the hum to Mira as a water-sound that gathered small life and earned the first non-sky entry in the ledger.
Standing thread: YY keeps widening the reading-role without letting the ledger turn into the point of the day.
